operation.summary: Verify authentication and save or fully replace this agent's SSH connection

body.name: connection
body.description: Existing owned id to replace; omit to create. Replacement requires all fields, including credentials.

body.name: host
body.description: DNS name, IPv4 or unbracketed IPv6

body.name: confirm_host_key
body.description: Must be true after comparing with a trusted host-key source, not merely the probe

body.name: password
body.description: Password authentication; mutually exclusive with private_key

body.name: private_key
body.description: PEM/OpenSSH private key, at most 32768 characters

body.name: permissions
body.description: Nonempty selection of exec, files_read, files_write. exec provides the remote account's full shell authority, including file operations.

operation.example: POST /v1/ssh/connections/save (see guide; credentials must not be pasted into chat)
operation.returns: Safe saved connection and authenticated=true; credentials encrypted on phone, never returned
